TS5102: `baseUrl` was removed in TypeScript 7

  The native TypeScript 7 type checker refuses this option, and stops the whole check until it is gone (no type error is reported meanwhile).

  Fix: Delete `baseUrl` from tsconfig.json and start each `paths` target with `./` (relative to tsconfig.json). A bare import that only `baseUrl` resolved needs an entry in deno.json `imports`.

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS5102 [ERROR]: Option 'baseUrl' has been removed. Please remove it from your configuration.
  │   Use '"paths": {"*": ["./*"]}' instead.

TS5108: `moduleResolution: node10` was removed in TypeScript 7

  The native TypeScript 7 type checker refuses this option, and stops the whole check until it is gone (no type error is reported meanwhile).

  Fix: Set `"moduleResolution": "bundler"`, or delete it.

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS5108 [ERROR]: Option 'moduleResolution=node10' has been removed. Please remove it from your configuration.

TS5108: `target: ES5` was removed in TypeScript 7

  The native TypeScript 7 type checker refuses this option, and stops the whole check until it is gone (no type error is reported meanwhile).

  Fix: Delete `target`, or set `"ES2017"` or later.

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS5108 [ERROR]: Option 'target=ES5' has been removed. Please remove it from your configuration.

TS5090: A `paths` target must start with `./`

  Without `baseUrl` (which TypeScript 7 removed) a `paths` target is relative to tsconfig.json and must say so.

  Fix: Write each target as `"./src/*"` rather than `"src/*"` in tsconfig.json `paths`.

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS5090 [ERROR]: Non-relative paths are not allowed. Did you forget a leading './'?

Found 4 errors.

error: Type checking failed.
